name: io.github.osjayaprakash/garmin-watch-mcp
title: Garmin Watch (Garmin Connect)
description: Read-only Garmin watch sleep, heart rate, stress, Body Battery, HRV and activities

environmentVariables.name: GARMIN_EMAIL
environmentVariables.description: Garmin Connect account email (not needed once tokens are saved)

environmentVariables.name: GARMIN_PASSWORD
environmentVariables.description: Garmin Connect account password (not needed once tokens are saved)

environmentVariables.name: GARMINTOKENS
environmentVariables.description: Directory holding saved tokens, or the token JSON itself (from `garmin-watch-mcp login --print-tokens`)

environmentVariables.name: GARMIN_IS_CN
environmentVariables.description: Set to true for Garmin Connect China (garmin.cn) accounts
